caption: The drawing shows a square composition with a decorative quilt-like pattern. Inside the square, there are four identical units, each containing a symmetrical arrangement of green, yellow, and red shapes resembling abstract floral or leaf forms. Each unit contains four large green rounded shapes paired with smaller green shapes, a yellow oval shape, and two red petal-like forms. The background of the patterned area is filled with a light beige crosshatched texture. At the intersections of the four units and the corners of the patterned area, there are bright red diamond or quarter-circle shapes. The entire patterned section is bordered by a thick golden-yellow stripe, followed by a wider beige stripe with diagonal hatch marks. The drawing is set on an off-white background.
title: Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
